meta.titleChess3d: 3D chess — play chess online on a 3D board — cv.cm
meta.descChess3d: Play 3D chess online for free: a real 3D board you can turn and tilt, against the computer at five levels or with a friend. No download, works on phones.

3d-chess.name: 3D chess
3d-chess.blurb: Chess on a 3D board you can turn, against the computer or a friend.

3d-chess.q1: How do I move a piece in 3D chess?
3d-chess.a1: Tap or click a piece, then tap one of the marked squares. Small dots show legal moves and rings show captures. Tap the piece again to drop it.
3d-chess.a2: There are five levels, from a beginner who blunders to a strong club player. The computer is the Stockfish engine, slowed down and capped on the easier levels.
3d-chess.q3: How do I turn the board on a phone?
3d-chess.a3: Drag across the board with one finger, or with two, to turn and tilt the view; a short tap picks a square. Turn the board flips it to the other side, and full screen gives you the most room.
3d-chess.a4: Yes. Every move is saved in this browser, so the game is waiting for you when you come back. Nothing is uploaded.
3d-chess.q5: Why does it say 3D is not available?
3d-chess.a5: 3D chess needs WebGL. Update the browser, turn on hardware acceleration or try another browser. The flat chess board on cv.cm works without it.

3d-chess.lead: Play chess on a 3D board in three steps.
3d-chess.s1b: Choose to play the computer or a friend, your colour and a level, then press Play to set up the 3D board.
3d-chess.s2b: Tap a piece, then a marked square. With a keyboard, arrow keys move the cursor and Enter picks a square.
3d-chess.s3b: Drag to turn and tilt the board, or press Turn the board. Undo takes back your last move.

chess3d.title: 3D chess
chess3d.privacyNote: Play chess on a 3D board against the computer or a friend. The game runs in this page and is saved in this browser.
chess3d.intro: A 3D board, ready when you are. The computer's engine and the 3D view load when you press Play.
chess3d.hint: Tap a piece, then a marked square. Drag to turn and tilt the view. Keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter or Space picks a square, Esc lets go of a piece.
